description: Replay an existing E2E acceptance test script in a real browser to verify your app still works correctly — use this for regression testing after code changes. The browser executes each saved step and captures screenshots so you can see what happened. Requires: (1) test script metadata from muggle-remote-test-script-get, (2) actionScript content from muggle-remote-action-script-get using the testScript.actionScriptId, (3) testCaseDescription, the description from muggle-remote-test-case-get, and (4) a localhost URL. Anything the test must or must not touch, including which target and which path, goes in the test case's stored description before the run. A limit stated only in chat with the coding agent does not reach the run. Launches an Electron browser — the user's showElectronBrowser preference decides whether its window shows when set to always or never; under ask it defaults to a visible window and showUi: false runs it headless.

baseBranch.description: Base branch if not origin's default (e.g. a stacked parent).

cwd.description: Absolute path of the caller's worktree; keys the single-flight lock. A loopback run is refused unless it holds its base's latest commit.

displayResolution.description: Browser resolution, e.g. R_0390x0844. Defaults to the script's recorded size.

freshSession.description: Copy actionParams.freshSession from muggle-remote-action-script-get so the replay starts as recorded: true clears all session storage (cookies, localStorage) first. Absent there (an older recording): true only for clean-state tests (registration, login, cookie consent). Default: false.

lightMode.description: true runs the Standard tier (Claude Sonnet 5.5, faster and lower cost). Default false runs the Premium tier (Claude Opus 5.5, the default).

localUrl.description: Local URL to test against (e.g., http://localhost:3000)

mutations.description: Mutation parameters: string[] where each element is a plain-English instruction or a local file path (e.g. ["The post content should be 'Hello'", "Attach the image at C:\\Users\\user\\photo.jpg"]).

emailSecretId.description: Secret ID (UUID) of the secret holding the account email

passwordSecretId.description: Secret ID (UUID) of the secret holding the account password

pinnedAccount.description: Copy from actionParams.pinnedAccount of the muggle-remote-action-script-get result: the account the script was recorded as, not the test case's current pin. A pinned replay runs in that account's own browser session; omit when the recording carries none.

showUi.description: Show the electron-app UI during replay. Ignored when the user's showElectronBrowser preference is always (shown) or never (headless); under ask it defaults to visible and false runs headless.

testCaseDescription.description: Copy description from muggle-remote-test-case-get for testScript.testCaseId: the replay reads the current text, not the text from when the script was recorded. Anything the test must or must not touch, including which target and which path, goes in the test case's stored description before the run. A limit stated only in chat with the coding agent does not reach the run.

actionScriptId.description: Action script ID (UUID) — use muggle-remote-action-script-get to fetch the full script

testCaseId.description: Cloud test case ID (UUID) this script was generated from

url.description: Original cloud URL (replaced by localUrl during execution)

name: muggle-local-execute-replay
